minimal_native_fields.run: exact Git commit + all source/protocol/config/input SHA + full CLI/environment + immutable output SHA
minimal_native_fields.original_support: source bag SHA, case, physical record_index, message SHA, component path/link; exact integer header/receive ns, complete eligible bin support
minimal_native_fields.decision: state/cutoff integer ns; all dependencies and shadow identity; raw/corrected range, prediction, innovation, exact consistency formula, variance source and score; explicit null/unknown
minimal_native_fields.action: health before/after, persistence/hysteresis counters, reason, actual old/new weight and meaning, factor existence, graph admission/rejection/recovery/fallback and factor ID
minimal_native_fields.shadow: excluded link, all external init/prediction/optimizer initial guess/history/cache/prior/score-pose roots, complete incident factor lineage; own state/prior and geometry; no main posterior reuse
minimal_native_fields.objective: all active factor IDs, realized weights, state, raw/P1 inputs, priors, angular and other factors, independent-cost snapshots including rejected/absent constraint ledger
